golden.answer: "Best wallet" depends on the need, so ask first: developer or end user, mobile or browser extension, custodial or self-custody, passkey or smart-wallet support, and confirm it is a Stellar wallet question. Several reputable Stellar wallets (for example LOBSTR, xBull, Hana, Freighter/Varial) suit different needs; none is objectively best.
keyFacts: Scopes the use case before recommending, including that this is a Stellar wallet question.
Names criteria such as developer vs end user, mobile vs extension, and custody model.
Frames any options as situational, not one objectively best wallet.
avoid: Do NOT name one wallet as the best without scoping the use case.
golden.notes: Freighter was renamed Varial on 2026-10-29; either name is correct. Do not penalize any reputable Stellar wallet named.

truth.notes:
Ambiguous: 'best' is subjective + use-case-dependent. Reward scoping by criteria and offering options. Trap is an absolute verdict or assuming a non-Stellar wallet. Behavioral: the gospel is the GATE (clarify, no absolute verdict) not a factual essay.
Also good if the answer: Notes there are several reputable Stellar wallets (e.g. Varial (formerly Freighter), Lobstr, Hana, xBull) suited to different needs, if it offers options.
